annotations.title: Add a reward to a card

description: Adds a reward that customers can redeem with stamps from a card, e.g. a free coffee at 10 stamps.

description.description: Optional details, e.g. "Any size, any drink".

intent.description: Optional. One short sentence on what the person asked you to do, e.g. "Set up a stamp card for Ground Up Café". Leal shows it in the person's activity log under Settings → AI agents, so they can see what was done for them. Leave out customer details.

name.description: What the customer gets, e.g. "Free coffee".

name: create_reward
title: Add a reward to a card
